1 - Container is tracked in InSite at the serial level
2 - Container is tracked in InSite at the bulk level
3 - Container is not tracked in InSite ... quantity and lot are recorded
4 - non lot controlled ( floor stock ) stock point is recorded no lot info
5 - recording quantities only
6 - issue quantities are displayed but not recorded
